title: unknown-outcome-reconciliation-report acceptance evidence

preconditions.const: Operations: identity.delivery.cancel, identity.delivery.enqueue, identity.delivery.receipt-record, identity.delivery.reconcile, identity.delivery.status-get; exact inputs: operation_id, idempotency_key, reconciliation_id, commit_fault; initial state: response is lost exactly at a PostgreSQL commit or external acceptance boundary

stimulus.const: Run identity.delivery.cancel then identity.delivery.enqueue then identity.delivery.receipt-record then identity.delivery.reconcile then identity.delivery.status-get for success, failure, outage, concurrency, cleanup, unknown-outcome cases using operation_id, idempotency_key, reconciliation_id, commit_fault and capture every required artifact field

expected_outcome.const: Invariant: reconciliation returns committed or not_committed from durable identity and retry never duplicates the mutation or event; stable outcomes: success=pass/none, failure=failed/internal, outage=unavailable/unavailable, concurrency=pass/conflict, cleanup=pass/none, unknown-outcome=reconciled/unknown_commit; required artifact fields: reconciliation_id, committed_count, not_committed_count, duplicate_effect_count, reconciliation_digest, delivery_outcome_cases
